summary: The diff addresses all three requirements. REQ-35 is handled by adding a userIdCounter and generateUserId() in main.mo with a migration module. REQ-36 is handled by updating UserManagementPage.tsx to display user IDs and invalidate queries. REQ-37 is handled by updating AuthContext.tsx to call actor.login() instead of hardcoded credentials, and main.mo's login function looks up users from the full users map. All core acceptance criteria appear to be met.

hallucinated_features.description: A migration module (backend/migration.mo) was added that migrates old user records without an 'id' field by setting id = email. This migration approach for pre-existing data was not requested in any requirement.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request only asks for new users to have a generated ID. The migration module addresses existing records but was not specified as a requirement.
